summary: Full end-to-end test of RAKSHAK marketing site (frontend) and contact-form backend. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed. Frontend Playwright: 50/50 assertions passed across Home, Become-a-Guard, About, Contact pages, header nav, footer, mobile nav, FAQ accordion, ScrollToTop, download CTA preventDefault, and a live contact form submission that returned a sonner success toast.

minor.issue: In the except branch (server.py L93-95), `logger` is referenced but `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is initialised AFTER include_router/CORS setup (L128). It works only because handlers run after module load completes, but the ordering is fragile — initialise logger before route definitions.

action_items: (optional) Reorder logger initialisation above route definitions in /app/backend/server.py for robustness.

(optional, scope-of-PRD) Add finer-grained data-testid attributes on /become-a-guard cards (eligibility-1..4, doc-chip-1..4, benefit-1..6, join-step-1..5, standard-1..3) and on /about (pillar-mission, pillar-vision, pillar-operate, timeline-1..4, value-1..4, presence-card) to make future regression tests deterministic. The pages render correctly and contain the expected content, but only hero/CTA testids exist today.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` used (L94) before assignment block (L128). Works due to load ordering but should be hoisted.
server.py L18-20: `os.environ[...]` will KeyError on missing env — acceptable per spec (fail-fast) and current .env is healthy.
Frontend: Download buttons correctly use preventDefault (verified URL unchanged after click). Coming-Soon labelling present.
Header: confirmed NO login / sign-in / sign-up button anywhere on public pages — matches PRD.
Footer: contact email = contactus@therakshak.in (exact match), all 5 cities present with data-testid, Privacy/Terms/DPDP links present and use preventDefault.
Contact form: sonner toast 'Message received — we'll respond within 24 hours.' shown after successful POST to /api/contact. Backend persists and returns the new submission.
Validation: invalid email (422), missing required fields (422), empty message (422) — all enforced server-side via Pydantic + EmailStr.
test_credentials: n/a — site is public, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed contact submissions inserted into MongoDB collection contact_submissions during tests (safe to leave or purge via Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend external URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. App is a static marketing site + a single contact-submission endpoint; MongoDB collection: contact_submissions. No auth flows. Public pages: /, /become-a-guard, /about, /contact. All key elements expose data-testid attributes (hero-headline, nav-*, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email-input, contact-phone, contact-topic, contact-message, contact-submit, footer-contact-email, footer-link-{privacy,terms,dpdp}, footer-city-{delhi,gurugram,noida,ghaziabad,faridabad}, how-step-1..4, trust-pillar-1..6, use-case-1..6, category-1..4, review-1..3, faq-item-1..6, hero-download-google/apple, cta-download-*, mobile-nav-toggle, mobile-nav-panel, home-recruit-cta).
rca of the issue: No defects found in scope. The only nit is the ordering of `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` after the route definitions in server.py — currently harmless because by the time `create_contact` actually runs the module has finished loading, but if anyone refactors to call the handler at import time it will NameError. Hoist the logger init above the routes for defensive coding.
